stage1.impression: A calm, warm golden-hour room with a convincing plaster wall, real oak floor and coherent window-mullion shadows; the two green horn speakers read clearly and the horn shadows on the wall agree with the low sun from the left. But the speakers' fronts are filled flat from the camera side so the woofer covers wash out to pale sage and the cabinet interiors glow like emissive neon, the dead-centred symmetric framing reads as a catalogue plate, and a sliver of window plus a hard grey jamb at the left edge distracts.

blocking_9: Woofer cover discs read as the dark #2E4A2C cover, not pale sage (disc lum_median under ~90, delta_e to #2E4A2C under 10)
Cabinet fronts modelled by the sun, with a lit side and a shadowed side, not filled evenly from the camera; the interior green reads as transmitted sun, not self-lit
No camera-side fill visible as studio light on the vase, credenza top or speaker fronts
The left edge resolves into either a readable window that explains the light or clean wall, not a 100 px sliver plus a hard jamb
No visible texture repetition (credenza veneer) and no denoiser smear on wood grain at delivery size

change.setting: lamp north and lamp bounce irradiance

matte warm grey stoneware #B8AFA2 r0.6 at [0.55, 0.78, 0.56]
